import sys
import typing

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

from lookup import Group, User, find_group, find_user, members_of

users = [User(1, "Ada", "ada@example.com"), User(2, "Bob", "bob@example.com"), User(3, "ADA", "ada2@example.com"), User(4, "Cy", "cy@example.com")]
groups = [Group(10, "Admins", [1, 4]), Group(11, "Ops", [2]), Group(12, "ops ", [3]), Group(13, "OPS")]
print(find_user(users, " bob "), find_user(users, "nobody"), find_user([], "x"))
print(find_group(groups, "ADMINS"), find_group(groups[:2], "ops "), find_group(iter(groups), "none"))
for call in (lambda: find_user(users, "ada"), lambda: find_group(groups, "Ops")):
    try:
        print(call())
    except LookupError as exc:
        print("LookupError", exc)
print(members_of(groups, users, "admins"), members_of(groups, users, "missing"))
for func in (find_user, find_group):
    print(func.__name__, typing.get_type_hints(func))
print("ok")
